articles.title: Ameren announces higher winter electricity rates
articles.description: Ameren customers in Illinois will see higher winter energy bills this year due to tight supply and data center demand.

Ameren's non-summer rate is increasing to 10.4 cents per kilowatt hour, up from 8.7 cents last year.
